testSuite.name: IT Ticketing System - User Acceptance Test Cases
testSuite.description: Comprehensive test cases covering all application features and security validations

testCases.name: Register new end user with valid data
testSteps: Enter valid password: Test1234 (8+ chars, uppercase, lowercase, number)
expectedResults: User role is automatically set to 'end_user'
User is redirected to login page or dashboard
User can login with registered credentials
testCases.passCriteria: User registration succeeds and user can login

testCases.name: Register with invalid email format
testCases.passCriteria: Registration fails with appropriate error message

testCases.name: Register with weak password (less than 8 characters)
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'password must be at least 8 characters'
testCases.passCriteria: Registration fails with password length error

testCases.name: Register with password missing uppercase letter
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'password must contain at least one uppercase letter'
testCases.passCriteria: Registration fails with password strength error

testCases.name: Register with password missing lowercase letter
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'password must contain at least one lowercase letter'
testCases.passCriteria: Registration fails with password strength error

testCases.name: Register with password missing number
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'password must contain at least one number'
testCases.passCriteria: Registration fails with password strength error

testCases.name: Register with duplicate email
preconditions: User with email test@example.com already exists
testCases.passCriteria: Registration fails with duplicate email error

testCases.name: Login with valid credentials
preconditions: User account exists with email: admin@test.com, password: Admin123
expectedResults: Session cookie is set with HttpOnly and Secure flags (in production)
User information is displayed in navigation
testCases.passCriteria: User successfully logs in and is redirected to dashboard

testCases.name: Login with invalid email
testCases.passCriteria: Login fails with appropriate error message

testCases.name: Login with incorrect password
preconditions: User account exists with email: test@example.com
testCases.passCriteria: Login fails with appropriate error message

testCases.name: Login with inactive user account
preconditions: User account exists but is marked as inactive

testCases.name: Login rate limiting - exceed 5 requests per minute
expectedResults: First 5 attempts return 401 (unauthorized) or 200 (if credentials valid)
testCases.passCriteria: Rate limiting prevents brute force attacks

testCases.name: Register rate limiting - exceed 5 requests per minute
expectedResults: First 5 attempts succeed or fail based on data validity
testCases.passCriteria: Rate limiting works on registration endpoint

testCases.name: Logout successfully
testSteps: User is on any authenticated page
expectedResults: User is redirected to login page
User cannot access protected pages without re-login
testCases.passCriteria: Logout clears session and redirects to login

testCases.name: Access protected page without login
expectedResults: User is redirected to login page
Original URL is preserved in ?next= parameter
testCases.passCriteria: Unauthenticated users are redirected to login

testCases.name: Access login page while already logged in
expectedResults: User is automatically redirected to dashboard
testCases.passCriteria: Logged-in users cannot access login page

testCases.name: Create ticket as end user
preconditions: User is logged in as end_user
At least one active admin exists in system
expectedResults: Ticket is automatically assigned to an admin
User is redirected to ticket detail page
testCases.passCriteria: End user can create ticket and it's auto-assigned to admin

testCases.name: Create ticket as admin without assignee
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: Ticket is automatically assigned to the admin who created it
testCases.passCriteria: Admin-created tickets without assignee are auto-assigned to creator

testCases.name: Create ticket with title exceeding 200 characters
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'title too long (max 200 characters)'
Form remains on create ticket page
testCases.passCriteria: Title length validation prevents overly long titles

testCases.name: Create ticket with description exceeding 5000 characters
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'description too long (max 5000 characters)'

testCases.name: Create ticket with department exceeding 100 characters
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'department too long (max 100 characters)'

testCases.name: Create ticket with invalid priority
testSteps: Manually set priority to invalid value (via browser dev tools or API)

testCases.name: Create ticket with invalid category
testSteps: Manually set category to invalid value

testCases.name: View ticket list as authenticated user
preconditions: At least one ticket exists in system
expectedResults: Tickets show title, status, priority, assignee, updated date
Tickets are clickable and link to detail page

testCases.name: View ticket list as end user (filtered)
preconditions: User is logged in as end_user
Multiple tickets exist (some created by this user, some by others)
expectedResults: Only tickets created by the end_user are displayed
Tickets created by other users are not visible
testCases.passCriteria: End users only see their own tickets

testCases.name: Search tickets by title
preconditions: Multiple tickets exist with different titles
testSteps: Enter search query in search box: 'network'
expectedResults: Only tickets with 'network' in title or description are displayed

testCases.name: Search with query exceeding 100 characters
expectedResults: Search query is truncated to 100 characters
testCases.passCriteria: Long search queries are handled gracefully

testCases.name: Filter tickets by status
expectedResults: Only tickets with status 'Open' are displayed

testCases.name: Filter tickets by priority
expectedResults: Only tickets with priority 'High' are displayed

testCases.name: Filter tickets by category
expectedResults: Only tickets with category 'Software' are displayed

testCases.name: Filter tickets by assignee
preconditions: User is logged in as admin or agent
Tickets assigned to different users exist
testSteps: Select assignee filter: specific user ID
expectedResults: Only tickets assigned to selected user are displayed

testCases.name: View ticket details with valid UUID
expectedResults: Ticket details are displayed (title, description, status, priority, category, assignee)
Assignee name and email are shown if assigned
Update form is visible (if user has permission)

testCases.name: View ticket with invalid UUID format
expectedResults: User is redirected or error page is shown

testCases.name: View non-existent ticket
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'not found' or 'resource not found'

testCases.name: Update ticket as admin
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
testCases.passCriteria: Admin can update all ticket fields

testCases.name: Update ticket as agent
preconditions: User is logged in as agent
expectedResults: Agent has same update permissions as admin

testCases.name: Update ticket as end user (should fail)
preconditions: User is logged in as end_user

testCases.name: Update ticket title exceeding 200 characters
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'title too long (max 200 characters)'
testCases.passCriteria: Title length validation works on update

testCases.name: Update ticket description exceeding 5000 characters
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'description too long (max 5000 characters)'
testCases.passCriteria: Description length validation works on update

testCases.name: Add comment to ticket
testSteps: Enter comment text: 'This is a test comment'
Click Add Comment or Submit button
testCases.passCriteria: Users can add comments to tickets

testCases.name: Add comment exceeding 2000 characters
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'comment too long (max 2000 characters)'

testCases.name: Add empty comment
testSteps: Leave comment field empty or enter only whitespace

testCases.name: Create user as admin
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: User can login with created credentials
testCases.passCriteria: Admin can create users with any role

testCases.name: Create user with admin role
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: User is created with admin role
New admin can login and has admin privileges
testCases.passCriteria: Admin can create other admin users

testCases.name: Create user with invalid email format
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
testCases.passCriteria: Email validation works in admin user creation

testCases.name: Create user with name exceeding 100 characters
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'name too long (max 100 characters)'

testCases.name: Create user with weak password
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: Error message displayed with password requirements

testCases.name: Create user with duplicate email
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
User with email test@example.com already exists

testCases.name: Create user as non-admin (should fail)
preconditions: User is logged in as agent or end_user
testSteps: Attempt to access user creation form
expectedResults: User creation form is not accessible

testCases.name: View user list as admin
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: Users show email, name, role, active status
Users are listed in table format

testCases.name: Search users by email or name
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: Users matching 'test' in email or name are displayed

testCases.name: Filter users by role
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: Only users with 'agent' role are displayed

testCases.name: Filter users by active status
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
Both active and inactive users exist

testCases.name: Update user role as admin
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: User can login and has agent privileges

testCases.name: Update user role with invalid role value
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
testSteps: Attempt to set user role to 'invalid_role'
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'invalid role. allowed: admin, agent, end_user'

testCases.name: Deactivate user as admin
preconditions: User is logged in as admin

testCases.name: Activate user as admin
preconditions: User is logged in as admin

testCases.name: Update own name as authenticated user
testSteps: Navigate to user profile or settings
expectedResults: Updated name is reflected in user profile
Updated name appears in navigation/user display
testCases.passCriteria: Users can update their own name

testCases.name: Update name exceeding 100 characters
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'name too long (max 100 characters)'
testCases.passCriteria: Name length validation works on update

testCases.name: Update own password with current password
preconditions: User is logged in as end_user or agent
testSteps: Navigate to password update page or form
expectedResults: User can login with new password
User cannot login with old password
testCases.passCriteria: Users can update their own password

testCases.name: Update password without current password (non-admin)
preconditions: User is logged in as end_user or agent
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'current password is required'
testCases.passCriteria: Current password is required for non-admins

testCases.name: Update password with incorrect current password
preconditions: User is logged in as end_user or agent
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'current password is incorrect'

testCases.name: Update user password as admin (without current password)
preconditions: User is logged in as admin
expectedResults: Password is updated successfully (admin bypasses current password requirement)
Target user can login with new password
testCases.passCriteria: Admins can update any user's password without current password

testCases.name: Update password with weak new password
expectedResults: Error message displayed with password requirements
testCases.passCriteria: Password strength validation works on update

testCases.name: Update another user's password as non-admin (should fail)
preconditions: User is logged in as end_user or agent
testSteps: Attempt to update password for different user ID
expectedResults: Error message displayed: 'can only update your own password'
testCases.passCriteria: Users can only update their own password

testCases.name: View summary report
expectedResults: Resolved in 7 days count is displayed
High/Critical open tickets count is displayed

testCases.name: Request body size limit - exceed 1MB
testSteps: Send POST request to any endpoint
expectedResults: Request is rejected with 400 Bad Request
testCases.passCriteria: Body size limit prevents DoS attacks

testCases.name: Error message sanitization in production
preconditions: Application is running in production mode (APP_ENV=prod)
testSteps: Trigger a database error (e.g., invalid query)
Observe error message returned to client
expectedResults: Generic error message is returned: 'an error occurred'
No database details, stack traces, or internal information is exposed
Detailed error is logged server-side only

testCases.name: Error message details in development
preconditions: Application is running in development mode (APP_ENV=dev)
testSteps: Observe error message returned to client
expectedResults: Developer can see actual error details

testCases.name: Cookie Secure flag in production
preconditions: Application is running in production mode (APP_ENV=prod)
expectedResults: Session cookie has Secure flag set to true
Cookie is only sent over HTTPS

testCases.name: Cookie Secure flag in development
preconditions: Application is running in development mode (APP_ENV=dev)
expectedResults: Session cookie has Secure flag set to false (for localhost)
testCases.passCriteria: Cookies work in development without HTTPS requirement

testCases.name: XSS attempt in ticket title
testSteps: Create ticket with title containing script: '<script>alert("XSS")</script>'
View ticket in list and detail page
expectedResults: Script tags are escaped and displayed as text

testCases.name: XSS attempt in ticket description
testSteps: Create ticket with description containing: ''
expectedResults: HTML is escaped and displayed as text

testCases.name: XSS attempt in comments
expectedResults: Comment is displayed as plain text

testCases.name: SQL injection attempt in search query
testSteps: Enter search query: "'; DROP TABLE tickets; --"
expectedResults: Query is treated as literal string

preconditions: User is logged in as end_user or agent

testCases.name: Update ticket as end user
preconditions: User is logged in as end_user

testCases.name: Admin link visibility

expectedResults: Admin link is visible in navigation
Admin Quick Access card is visible on home page
testCases.passCriteria: Admin users see admin navigation options

testCases.name: Admin link hidden for non-admins

testCases.name: Display validation errors
testSteps: Attempt to create ticket without title

testCases.name: Real-time form validation
preconditions: User is on registration or create ticket page
testSteps: Enter invalid data in form fields
expectedResults: Validation errors are shown before submission
Errors clear when data is corrected
Form prevents submission with invalid data

testCases.name: Loading indicator during API calls
testSteps: Perform action that triggers API call (create ticket, search, etc.)
expectedResults: Loading indicator or disabled state is shown
UI updates when response is received

testCases.name: Ticket list load time
testSteps: Measure time until list is displayed
testCases.passCriteria: Ticket list performs well with large datasets
